paper_metadata.title: A Fully Integrated CMOS Frequency Synthesizer With Charge-Averaging Charge Pump and Dual-Path Loop Filter for PCSand Cellular-CDMA Wireless Systems
paper_metadata.abstract: A fully integrated CMOS frequency synthesizer for PCSand cellular-CDMA systems is integrated in a 0.35m CMOS technology. The proposed charge-averaging charge pump scheme suppresses fractional spurs to the level of noise, and the improved architecture of the dual-path loop filter makes it possible to implement a large time constant on a chip. With current-feedback bias and coarse tuning, a voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO) enables constant power and low gain of the VCO. Power dissipation is 60 mW with a 3.0-V supply. The proposed frequency synthesizer provides 10-kHz channel spacing with phase noise of 121 dBc/Hz in the PCS band and 127 dBc/Hz in the cellular band, both at 1-MHz offset frequency.
